scenario_data.body: Epilogue
A little bit of time has passed since then.
I continued my recuperation at Famille, and have completely recovered.
Sayaka has resumed study at her college nursing department,
And has made all the arrangements to start nurse training next week.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (A lot has happened to this point, but...)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (It's all settled for the moment!)
Then, one day.
When Sayaka is walking back from school with me, after my injury has healed...

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh, that's right. William, are you free tomorrow?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Tomorrow?"
It's kind of abrupt, but I nod.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "It's alright. I don't have any classes tomorrow."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Good."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "The truth is, see. My nurse training starts next week, but..."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Before then, I want to go on another date with you♪"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Woah!Of course, it sounds nice!"
Thinking about it... was it because of my injury,
That I feel like I haven't gone on a date with Sayaka in a while.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Heh. Then, tomorrow it is♪"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Yeah!"
And so, the next day.
I come on my date with Sayaka.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Alright! Well, then, William, where should we go?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Shall we watch a movie? I'd also like to go shopping~"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh! I think the new sweets shop in front of the train station got finished!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hahaha. Sayaka, you're cheerful."
I just smile at her charming form.
And Sayaka nods happily as I do.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "After all, it's really been a long time since we had a date♪"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Also... so I can do my best in training from tomorrow, I want to have lots of fun today."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hahaha. I see."
And so... Sayaka turns to me in a flash.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Hey. William."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Thanks."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Huh?"
As I'm surprised by the abrupt thanks, Sayaka smiles as though reminiscing...

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "That I can take nurse training one more time..."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "... is thanks to you, William."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "So I wanted to give you my thanks one more time."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "N-No, that's..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "If I was able to be even a slight help to you, Sayaka, I'm glad."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Yeah♪"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Ok! Then, let's go!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Yes!"
After that, we see a movie, go shopping, and eat sweets...
And, alone together, fully enjoy our first date in a while.
And, on the way home.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Hmm~! We had a good time today~!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Yeah... Think < you can do your best in training from tomorrow?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Yeah! Completely!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hahaha. That's all that's important."
As we walk back, while making faint conversation...

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Hmm?)
Sayaka suddenly stops in front of a show window for some reason.
When I wonder why, and follow her gaze...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Whoa!"
What I find there is—a wedding dress exhibition.
A snow white dress is on display in a glass case.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Beautiful!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "It really is!"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Heh... Speaking of..."
Sayaka looks like she just remembered something.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "When my training is finished, and I become a nurse..."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "You better keep your promise to me, William♪"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Oh!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Th-Then, shall we choose a dress from this shop, right now?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Hahaha! Maybe I will♪ ~"
We exchange jokes and grow shy
When...

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "Welcome!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Huh!?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Hmm?"
A shop assistant abruptly comes out, and lowers her head.

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "If you'd like, you can try one on inside?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Huh...? T-Try what on???"

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "A wedding dress, of course."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Huhh!?"
Somehow,it seems we've been mistaken for a couple who came to choose a dress.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "N-No! We weren't! We were just looking..."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh, well, maybe I'll take this chance to try one on♪ ~"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Sayaka!?"
I hurriedly try to get away from the store, but...
Sayaka, conversely, and presses toward the store.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Heh. It's fine if I just try them on, right?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "And, William, don't you want to see me in one of these?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (S-Sayaka, in a wedding dress!?)
~~I really want to see it!

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I-I understand... shall we enter!"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Yeah♪"
And so, I enter the wedding dress exhibition together with Sayaka.
When we sit in the reception area, the person in charge appears immediately.

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "Welcome! Do you wish to try on a dress today?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Yes♪ Please allow me."

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "Understood! Here is the dress list."
Saying this, the shop assistant opens a large file.
In side, dress photos are lined up in rows.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Whoa! Wedding dresses have this much variety!?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Truly. They're all wonderful!"

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "Heh. Thank you."

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "My guest, how would this dress do?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Wow! Cute♪"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Sayaka, this dress is pretty, too."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Which one...? It really is!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Oh! But, this one might look better on you, Sayaka..."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh? Though I also like the dress you just looked at?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "No, no! Please pick the one you like best..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Since I want you to be the most beautiful bride."
After looking through the list in earnest for a while, I realize...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Err... Th-That's right. We were only going to try a dress on, today.)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I don't need to choose so earnestly... Hmm?)
As I glance at her, Sayaka's face is bright red for some reason.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Wh-What is it?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh... Th-that is..."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Ch-Chosing a dress... is a bit embarrassing, after all..."
Saying this, Sayaka nods bashfully, for once.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hahaha. Sayaka, you're cute when you're embarrassed."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Jeez! William!"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Y-You did that earlier, too, but... no more surprise attacks!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Huh? Wh-What do you mean by... Surprise attacks???"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Ugghh! I don't care anymore."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Huhhhhh???"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Wh-Why is Sayaka upset???)
Then, to hide her red face,
Sayaka points at a dress photo from the list.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "U-Umm! I'd like to try on this dress."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Oh!"
It's the last dress I selected during our earlier conversation.

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "Heh. I understand. Please wait a short moment."
When we wait a bit as told, a voice calls from the depths of the store.

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "Guest! The preparations are complete, so please come to the waiting room."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh. Yes, ma'am."

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "The man will please wait in the waiting room."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I understand."
And so, we split up, to the locker room, and waiting room.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Whoa! M-My heart's racing a bit!)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I'm really looking forward to seeing Sayaka in a dress!)
And I wait several minutes.

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "-Sorry for the wait!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Oh!)
The shop assistant calls out from across the locker room.

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "Her wedding form will now be unveiled!"

scenario_data.speaker: Shop assistant
scenario_data.body: "Please, follow me to this room!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Y-Yes!"
I firmly grab the locker room door's doorknob.
And...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (A-Alright... Here I go!)
I vigorously open the door.
*Click!*
On the other side of the door, the form of my girlfriend in a wedding dress,
I strongly, strongly etch into my chest...
On the way home...
I can't get the image of Sayaka in her dress out of my head.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "You were really, reaallly beautiful, Sayaka!"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "J...Jeez... I know already."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh, you, William. You've kept saying the same thing ever since we left the store."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "H-Hahaha!"
But the image of Sayaka in that dress was burned just that deeply in my heart.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I hope the day I can really have Sayaka wear that dress comes soon!)
We walk back with that pleasant mood.
After a little while, we arrive at Famille.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hmm~! We had a really good date, huh?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Yeah. We did."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Well then, shall we go home."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Huh...? Sayaka?"
Sayaka opens the door into Famille, but... stops there for some reason,

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "What is it?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Just... thinking about things a little."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Huh?"
With faintly stained cheeks... Sayaka glances up at me.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "If... we get married..."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Then will we greet each other like this at the entrance everyday?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Oh! I-I guess so."
Though embarrassed, I nod.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Sh-Shall we try it a little? Greeting each other..."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Oh!"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Y-Yeah."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Well then..."
I put the entrance to my back, and turn to Sayaka.
Just then...
*Whoosh!*
From somewhere, a strong wind lifts up.
Sayaka's hair gently floats in that wind...
-and the image of Sayaka in that dress flashes back before my eyes.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Is something wrong...? William."
That dress she tried on in the exhibition...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Sayaka...!)
I'm sure... a beauty that turns heads,means something like this.
Sayaka is that beautiful.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "What is it? You're staring..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "N-Nothing..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I was just thinking... you really are beautiful, Sayaka."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Huh!"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Jeez... William. Didn't I tell you to stop with those surprise attacks."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hahaha..."
The snow white dress sparkles in the sunset.
But also ephemeral, like it would dissolve in that light.
So... I think.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I want to hug this person right now——.)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Sayaka..."
So that this time of happiness with my precious girlfriend won't vanish,
I softly spread my hands, and say.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Welcome home..."
As though filling up with various emotions, Sayaka's eyes moisten.
And she approaches, one step at a time...
Sayaka fits comfortably in my chest.
*Squeeze!*
Sayaka strongly, strongly embraces me.
And I softly put my hand on her back.
Gazing at each other, approaching as though drawn to each other...

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Mm... Mmmm...!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Phew..."
We exchange kisses.
And finally... though reluctant to part, we separate.
Filled with belovedness, we both gaze at each other...
And Sayaka happily whispers in my ear.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "I'm home..."

_source: OCR of YouTube upload Sayaka_E02 (DevilGh0stz), part 1. Text is machine-read: expect small typos. Player name normalised to William. Field nesting is a guess.
